text.tspan: Each scenario runs a small stand-in program (a script named like the real tool) under whystuck.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
text.tspan: The stand-ins only imitate the stall. The inspection that follows (process tree, sockets, locks) is real.
